articles.author: Caroline Ryan
articles.headline: Databricks Makes Third Cyber Acquisition, Acquiring Panther Labs
articles.summary: Databricks has agreed to acquire Panther Labs, in a move that expands the data company's footprint in cybersecurity.
articles._summary: Databricks has agreed to acquire Panther Labs for an undisclosed price to expand the data company's footprint in cybersecurity . The San Francisco-based company positioned the deal as a step toward competing with larger rivals CrowdStrike and Splunk, Reuters reported. Panther Labs was last valued at $1.4 billion after a $120 million Series B round in 2021. The startup's product pulls security-relevant data streams into a single place so software "agents" can act on threats with minimal human involvement as attack volume rises alongside broader AI adoption. At Databricks' Data + AI Summit in San Francisco, CEO Ali Ghodsi argued that AI has accelerated how quickly attackers can turn software flaws into real intrusions and said older alert-and-log workflows were "dead." "If they’re going to attack you with agents, you have to defend with agents," Ghodsi told Reuters. "You have to fight fire with fire."
articles._zh_headline: Databricks 进行第三次网络收购，收购 Panther Labs
articles._zh_summary: Databricks 已同意以未公开的价格收购 Panther Labs，以扩大该数据公司在网络安全领域的业务。据路透社报道，这家总部位于旧金山的公司将此次交易定位为与规模更大的竞争对手 CrowdStrike 和 Splunk 竞争的一步。 Panther Labs 在 2021 年完成 1.2 亿美元的 B 轮融资后，其最新估值为 14 亿美元。这家初创公司的产品将与安全相关的数据流拉到一个地方，这样，随着攻击量随着人工智能的广泛采用而增加，软件“代理”可以在最少的人为参与的情况下应对威胁。在旧金山举行的 Databricks 数据 + 人工智能峰会上，首席执行官 Ali Ghodsi 表示，人工智能加快了攻击者将软件缺陷转变为真正入侵的速度，并表示旧的警报和日志工作流程已经“死亡”。 “如果他们要用特工攻击你，你就必须用特工来防御，”戈德西告诉路透社。 “你必须以毒攻毒。”

articles.headline: Tehran selling deal with US as victory – but for Iranians it was necessity
articles.summary: For many Iranians, the question is not whether the deal means victory, but whether it lowers prices and reduces fear of another war.
articles._summary: Iran's leadership is trying to present its emerging memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the US not as a retreat, but as the result of resistance and victory. That is not an easy argument to make. The country has just gone through a damaging war, the economy is under severe pressure, and parts of the Islamic Republic's own support base have spent months denouncing any compromise with Washington. There are also Iranians, both inside the country and abroad, who see the crisis not as a moment for diplomacy, but as an opportunity for regime change. This is the divided political landscape in which Tehran is now trying to sell the deal. Senior Iranian officials have framed the deal as a win. Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf, the Speaker of parliament and the leading Iranian figure in the talks, said Iran had taken "a long step towards final victory".
articles._zh_headline: 德黑兰与美国达成的协议被视为胜利——但对伊朗人来说这是必要的

articles.headline: The war with Iran is making oil changes pricier. And a deal won't solve it
articles.summary: The U.S. may be the world's biggest producer of crude oil, but that's not the case for motor oil. The cost of lubricants is soaring, and even a tentative deal to end the war won't solve the problem.
articles._summary: A mechanic pours motor oil into a funnel inside a Chevron Corp. gas station in Albuquerque, N.M., in July 2016. The cost of group III base oil, used in motor oil blends, has risen 175% since the start of the war with Iran, according to a trade group. Sergio Flores/Bloomberg via Getty Images hide caption The war in Iran has pushed up the price of crude oil and derivatives like gasoline , diesel and jet fuel — all of which have been making headlines for months. But less has been said about the rising price of motor oil, the lubricant that protects your car's engine from wear and tear. Your next oil change could be quite a bit more expensive. And even if the framework deal is signed this week, that problem isn't going away any time soon.

articles.headline: Cuba tourism collapses as US pressure campaign bites
articles.summary: The number of foreign visitors is down by 58% compared to last year, Cuban officials say, amid sanctions and an effective oil blockade.
articles._summary: The number of foreign travellers visiting Cuba has plummeted since the beginning of the year amid tightened US sanctions, figures released by Cuba's national statistics agency suggest. Fewer than 360,000 people visited the Communist-run island in the first five months of 2026, a decrease of 58.4% compared to the same period last year, according to Onei. The Trump administration has targeted the tourism sector, a key source of income for Cuba's beleaguered government, as part of its pressure campaign against the island's leadership. As a result, a number of foreign airlines and hotel operators have stopped operating  in Cuba, further driving down visitor numbers. Earlier this month, Air Canada announced it was suspending its flights to Cuba indefinitely, citing the "ongoing political and economic uncertainty" as its reason. The carrier had already stopped flying to the island in February because of a shortage of aviation fuel on the Caribbean island.

articles._zh_summary: 马萨诸塞州民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 周一将矛头指向唐纳德·特朗普总统不断增长的财富，她认为，尽管许多美国人的工资增长放缓，但今年总统的个人财富增加了约 14 亿美元。在 X 上的一篇帖子中，沃伦分享了一张图表，将特朗普不断上升的净资产与不断下降的实际工资增长进行比较，并指责总统将自己的经济利益置于美国工薪阶层的利益之上。
